items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: That was actually a Lou Stein tune that he had written for Charlie and Charlie did it with Buddy Stewart and Kai Winding. And it was recorded that way the first time, but then when we joined the band he wanted us to do it naturally

ctx.x: And so we did, but I had to change the key and do the whole thing over. And different instrumentation.

That was actually a Lou Stein tune that he had written for Charlie and Charlie did it with Buddy Stewart and Kai Winding. And it was recorded that way the first time, but then when we joined the band he wanted us to do it naturally, because it was a good record for him, a big record. So that’s how we started doing it. But we love it. I think it’s a great piece.
This particular arrangement reminds me of like how I usually hear “Green Dolphin Street” with the Latin and swing, back and forth. It’s a nice exchange.
